rounds.name: Kola Peninsula
rounds.fact: The Kola Peninsula in northwestern Russia lies almost entirely north of the Arctic Circle between the Barents and White Seas.

rounds.name: Hokkaido / Nemuro Strait
rounds.fact: The Nemuro Strait is a channel separating the Japanese island of Hokkaido from the Kuril Islands.

rounds.name: Gulf of Saint Lawrence
rounds.fact: The Gulf of Saint Lawrence is the outlet of the North American Great Lakes via the Saint Lawrence River into the Atlantic Ocean.

rounds.name: Zanzibar Archipelago
rounds.fact: The Zanzibar Archipelago is a group of islands off the coast of East Africa in the Indian Ocean.

rounds.name: Gulf of Carpentaria
rounds.fact: The Gulf of Carpentaria is a large, shallow sea enclosed on three sides by northern Australia and bounded on the north by the Arafura Sea.
